title: A functional law of large numbers for a spatial model of Muller's ratchet
summary: The spatial Muller's ratchet is a model introduced by Foutel-Rodier and Etheridge to study the impact of cooperation and competition on the fitness of an expanding asexual population. The model is an interacting particle system consisting of particles performing symmetric random walks that reproduce and die with rates that depend on the local number of particles.
